newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- No-show passengers cost Arab carriers $4 billion a year.
- The Saudi Health Ministry wants milk to substitute soft drinks in schools.
- The Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company signs deals for ammonia and urea plants.
- Agricultural products accounted for around 11.9 percent of the non-oil gross national product of Saudi Arabia, or 34.8 billion riyals, in 1995.
- Saudi Arabia gave Palestinians a grant of nine million riyals.
- The value of trade between Saudi Arabia and France hovered around 14 billion riyals in 1996.
